description: Distinct question assignments for AB-100 study sessions. New questions are researched and added before each study day; deliberate reuse is reserved for review and mock days.

generationPolicy.studyDays: Use newly researched questions that have not appeared on an earlier study day.
generationPolicy.reviewDays: Previously answered questions may be reused intentionally for weak-area review.
generationPolicy.mockDays: Previously answered questions may be reused in a weighted exam simulation.
generationPolicy.sourcePolicy: Prefer official or reputable sourced questions; otherwise use original AI-generated exam-style questions explicitly labeled and grounded in current Microsoft Learn URLs.
